newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan navy ship, S.Korean gas transporter collide.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan navy ship, S.Korean gas transporter collide.

text.p: A Taiwan navy ship carrying hundreds of civilians collided with a South Korean gas transporter off the island's northern port of Keelung on Friday, Taiwan military officials said. No casualties were reported.
The accident occurred about 15 miles offshore as the navy vessel headed towards Matsu island, a major Taiwan defence outpost within sight of the Chinese mainland.
"The navy supply ship was en route to Matsu when the South Korean freighter rammed into its hold," a navy spokesman told Reuters by telephone.
The Korean vessel was transporting liquefied natural gas but the impact apparently caused no serious damage and no explosions were reported, the officer added.
The Taiwan ship suffered serious damage to its hold.
All of the 568 people aboard the navy ship were safe. They comprised 92 military servicemen and 476 civilians who were being transported to Matsu.
The civilians were put aboard another naval ship to complete the voyage to the heavily fortified strategic island, a front line in Nationalist-ruled Taiwan's 48-year rivalry with communist China.
